name: the Spirit Ring
note: The small capture the flag arena (handlers/ctf.go, entity/ctf.go; claude-notes/ctf-ring-20261111.md): one zone of the disc where it stands, Spirit Talkers Wood (Tunaria's cell 5, 5), whose north-east corner holds a round hollow ringed by unclimbable walls, about 550 across along its long axis (south-west to north-east) and 460 across its short one, its floor low at either end of the long axis and a mound in its middle. Every client's walk is closed in it (a walk-reach flood fill finds no way out even at slopes of 6:4). The field is the hollow: each team's camp and stand at an end of the long axis, the two speed shrines at the ends of the short one, the mending spring on the mound. Built by cmd/worldbuild from the operator's disc; the arena block is read by the server, never written into the file. The Canyon of Banners (tools/worlds/arena.json, slot 11) is the first, much larger arena, kept.

zones.name: Spirit Ring
zones.note: Spirit Talkers Wood (cell 5, 5): the round hollow in its north-east corner, centred near (11590, 11540), is the field; the rest of the zone (a wood within a wall of cliffs) is outside the field's edge

arena.name: the Spirit Ring
arena.note: A round hollow: Ember's camp and stand at its south-west end, Dusk's at its north-east, 320 apart straight (the mound between), the West and East Wind Shrines at the ends of the short axis, each as far from both stands, the Mending Spring on the mound. The field's edge is a circle round the hollow's centre (field_circle) that takes in the whole floor and the lower slopes: a player past it, up the steepest ends of the rim, goes back to its camp. Banners: the CHAR.ESF orbs (no zone art of Highbourne is resident here unless the decoration copies it in: flag_body with fallback_body, as the Canyon's).
